name: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
desc: A Gumowski-Mira strange attractor whose nonlinear recurrence breeds swirling mandalas, insectoid shells and galactic filaments that perpetually morph as a and b drift, its log-density point cloud glowing magenta-to-cyan on a deep indigo ground.

density.doc: orbit / iterate count (sparse sparkle -> dense body)

morph.doc: how far/fast a,b drift -> speed the creature reshapes

hue.doc: palette base hue (rotates the whole ramp)

style.doc: render philosophy: deep-sea glow / indigo-gold silk / blackbody ember / electric plasma / graphite-on-cream sketch

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
